cause: The installed jpackage launcher (OpenJDK 17.0.21) restarts itself on essentially every Windows launch: the launcher the owner starts creates a child launcher of the same image in the same console, with inherited handles and a kill-on-close job, waits for it, ignores Ctrl+C and exits with its code; the child runs the JVM. So a stream client's console holds three members, and the client exits only after its child.
execution: Only module definitions run. Logical kernel and guest peers answer in the recorded shapes; no process, console, socket or Win32 call is made.
